description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectActivityDao class, which implements data access operations for project activities within the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes methods for retrieving, counting, copying, and deleting project activities, as well as validation and consistency checks.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling CRUD and query operations related to ProjectActivity entities.

methods.name: getProjectActivityListByProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProjectActivity entities associated with a specific project ID, optionally filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for paginated retrieval of project activities based on filters.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of project activities matching specified filters for a given project ID.

methods.name: saveProjectActivity
methods.description: Persists a ProjectActivity entity to the database, saving new or updated entities.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Fetches a Project entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getProjectActivityByProjectIdAndProjectActivityId
methods.description: Retrieves a specific ProjectActivity based on project and activity IDs.

methods.name: getExistingProjectActivityIdsForProject
methods.description: Checks for existing project activity IDs within a given project, ignoring deleted entries.

methods.name: hasActivityGotTimesheetItems
methods.description: Checks if a specific project activity has associated timesheet items.

methods.name: deleteProjectActivities
methods.description: Marks specified project activities as deleted after ensuring they have no associated timesheet items, throwing an exception if they do.

methods.name: isProjectActivityNameTaken
methods.description: Validates whether a project activity name is already taken within a project, optionally excluding a specific activity ID during updates.

methods.name: getDuplicatedActivities
methods.description: Finds activities that are duplicated across a project, i.e., with the same name appearing more than once.

methods.name: getProjectActivitiesByActivityIds
methods.description: Retrieves all ProjectActivity entities given a list of activity IDs.

methods.name: copyActivities
methods.description: Copies activities from one project to another by creating new activity entries.

methods.name: getActivitiesCountByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Counts activities based on pairs of project and activity IDs, used for validation or report purposes.

methods.name: getActivitiesPaginatorByProjectActivityIdPairs
methods.description: Helper method that constructs a paginator for activities matching specific pairs of IDs to support count and fetch operations.
